2) If by email, what fields must be present on the PDF? Do you need a PO number on every invoice?

Hi Marta —

Thanks for sending the packet. Quick answers while I loop in AP:
- Preferred: our vendor portal (procure.redwoodinference.com). Portal-submitted invoices are processed faster and automatically matched to POs.
- Email: we accept PDF invoices to ap-invoices@redwoodinference.com only when portal submission isn't possible.
- Required fields (portal or email): Redwood PO number (if one was issued), invoice date, invoice number, line item description, quantity, unit price, subtotal, tax, total, remit-to details, and vendor tax id (EIN).

Laura / Priyom — do we have any exceptions for initial onboarding invoices or specific file-naming expectations to share?

If you prefer, I can send an example invoice template (xlsx) for Acme to mirror.

Best,

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: Vendor setup / invoice submission — quick questions (Acme Health)

Karthik — agree with portal-first. Official AP guidance to provide: 

1) Portal preferred: procure.redwoodinference.com. Invoices submitted via portal are matched to POs and processed within our standard 30-day payment terms once matched.

2) Email exception: ap-invoices@redwoodinference.com only. We will accept emailed PDFs for up to 30 calendar days from first invoice submission if portal access is pending. After 30 days, future invoices must go through the portal.

3) Required fields for ANY invoice (portal or email):
- Redwood PO number (if a PO exists)
- Invoice date and invoice number
- Line-level descriptions matching the PO (description, qty, unit price)
- Subtotal, tax, and total
- Vendor legal name and remit-to (address + ACH details if provided)
- Vendor tax identifier (EIN) and W-9 on file

4) File naming / attachments: PDF file name should be VendorName_INV_<invoice-number>_PO<PO-number>.pdf when emailing (example: AcmeHealth_INV_0001_PO12345.pdf). If PO not available, omit the PO portion.

5) Remittance / ACH: We provide ACH/virtual account details after vendor enrollment is complete and W-9 is verified. For initial invoices, payment will be issued to the remit-to on the invoice; ACH will be enabled after enrollment (we will share ACH instructions via the portal).

6) Exceptions & Escalations: If vendor needs longer than 30 days, CS/partnerships can request an exception by emailing ap-escalations@redwoodinference.com with justification.

I'll attach our example invoice template and the vendor onboarding checklist for Acme to mirror.

Laura Bennett
Director, Accounts Payable
Redwood Inference
attachments: example_invoice_template.xlsx, vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf

Hi Marta — quick wrap-up from AP below (copied Laura):

- Preferred: portal (procure.redwoodinference.com). We'll prioritize portal invoices.
- Email exception: ap-invoices@redwoodinference.com for up to 30 days while portal access is provisioned. Please use the file-naming convention: AcmeHealth_INV_<invoice-number>_PO<PO-number>.pdf (omit PO if none).
- Required fields: PO (if issued), invoice date/number, line-item detail, qty, unit price, subtotal/tax/total, vendor legal name, remit-to address, vendor EIN.
- ACH info: will be shared through the portal after W-9 verification.

I've attached the example invoice template and the onboarding checklist link to help your AP team. If you want, I can open the portal access request and track it with our ops team so you can submit the invoice there sooner — let me know and I'll start the ticket.
